premises.text: Users do not know what personal data they generate or who can see it, while platforms monetize that data
premises.evidence_span: the average user has no idea what data they're generating or who can see it, let alone how to actually secure their data

premises.text: Users sync platforms to view anonymized encrypted personal data organized in categories with a user-held private key
premises.evidence_span: Simply sync your platforms, like Facebook and Google, to see all of your personal data organized in simple categories, fully anonymized and encrypted

premises.text: A reverse subscription lets approved companies pay users monthly for access to anonymized data
premises.evidence_span: Ozone offers a reverse subscription model where companies you approve can pay to subscribe to your anonymized data

premises.text: Encrypted machine learning matches only user-approved data to targeted offers and pre-approved business audiences
premises.evidence_span: Ozone then runs encrypted machine learning to match only the data you want to share with offers that are targeted for you

premises.text: Freemium model: free consumer data tools; companies pay for conversions from pre-approved audiences
premises.evidence_span: consumers get simple, free tools to organize and secure their personal data, and companies get pre-approved audiences and only pay for conversions

domains.name: encrypted user data vault and matching

value.text: Users regain control of their data and share in the value companies earn from it
value.evidence_span: Take back control of your data, and take back the billions that big data is earning on you

causal_links.evidence_span: Data control should be a fundamental human right with equal data rights for all
Our patented technology encrypts your data and only you have the private key
For each subscription, you receive a monthly payment

notes: Patents folded into encryption/matching mechanism (v1.3.1 IP rule). Intelligence portal and 401k roadmap treated as product extensions of the same vault/monetization theory rather than independent premises. Enterprise customer counts excluded as traction.
